title: platymiscium pinnatum
intro: Platymiscium pinnatum, commonly known as Quebra-pedra, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine in the Amazon region, and its health benefits include aiding in the treatment of kidney stones and urinary tract infections due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Platymiscium pinnatum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
